method: K32 and RVQ jointly refine their books and offline label sequences for overlapping 5-step and 10-step executed-motion endpoint FDE, with no whole-route FDE or step ADE in the primary fitting loss. Both horizons use the same sequence. K32 keeps 32 motion IDs plus STOP=0, one token per motion, and >=5cm near-straight spacing. RVQ keeps 3x256 residual choices, 3 tokens per motion and H5 additive decoding; only executable components of its book are refined, other H5 components remain fixed and valid-increment/candidate guards remain active. K64 retains its current endpoint-optimized release.

encoder.fallback: always retain per-step nearest code; extend limits to its residual +3cm/+3deg

k32.fallback: always retain per-step nearest code; extend limits to its residual +3cm/+3deg

rvq.initialization: deterministic beam16 H5 seed from the current codebook and GT; no historical labels or books are required
rvq.primary_objective: sum of rolling 5/10-step SE(2) endpoint distances from the same executed first-action sequence
rvq.secondary_regularization: 1e-4 normalized first action squared residual + 0.002 masked H5 squared position/yaw residual
rvq.candidate_constraints: all valid H5 increments must exceed 5cm or 5deg; first action residual <=max(8cm,seed+3cm), yaw <=max(12deg,seed+3deg); masked H5 mean position <=max(8cm,seed+3cm), yaw <=max(6deg,seed+3deg)
rvq.codebook_fitting: refine executable first 3 of 15 dimensions; preserve remaining future components; equal source/horizon endpoint loss plus weak center anchor
